title: RunAssignment
description: A job dispatched from the control plane to a runner. Contains everything the runner needs to execute one agent turn.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run. Assigned by the control plane.

thread_id.description: The thread this run executes on.

runner_kind.description: Identifies which runner should handle this job (e.g., 'python-langgraph').

input.description: The input to the agent. Shape is defined by the agent, not this protocol. Null means no input (resume-only).

config.description: Agent configuration passed through to the framework.

configurable.description: Key-value pairs the agent can read. thread_id and run_id are injected by the runner.

recursion_limit.description: Maximum recursion depth for the agent.

metadata.description: Additional metadata passed to the agent framework.

user.description: Authenticated identity from the control plane's auth layer (flat wire shape). Runners SHOULD expose this to the agent (e.g. LangGraph langgraph_auth_user / runtime.user). Absent when no auth provider is configured.

is_authenticated.description: Whether the caller presented a valid identity.

checkpoint_ref.description: Opaque checkpoint identity for resume-by-id (time-travel). Null/absent means resume from the thread's latest checkpoint (or a fresh run). LangGraph runners map a non-empty value to configurable.checkpoint_id; non-LangGraph runners must error rather than ignore.

resume_command.description: If non-null, this run is resuming from an interrupt. Contains the client's response.

interrupt_id.description: The interrupt this response is for.

response.description: The client's response data. Shape defined by the agent.

stream_modes.description: Which data event types the control plane wants. Well-known: values, updates, messages, custom. Unknown strings are passed through for forward compatibility. lifecycle/end/error events are always emitted regardless.

connector_needs.description: Pre-warm hint for connector sessions. NOT an allow-list.

allowed_tools.description: Optional in-graph tool allowlist. Absent = no runner-side filter. Present (including empty) = runner must refuse tool names not listed before side effects. Distinct from connector policy grants.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that authenticated the originating request. Runners scope direct-mode store/vector SQL and proxy X-Runkite-Tenant-Id headers to this value. Absent on older control planes -- runners fall back to "default". Does not tenant-scope LangGraph's own checkpoint tables.

trace_context.description: W3C Trace Context for cross-process observability.

correlation_id.description: Request correlation ID for logging. Any non-empty string.
